name: Herdr PiP
description:
Herdr agent status in a floating badge that stays visible over fullscreen windows.

* A ring and a dot show when an agent is working, done or blocked
* Click the badge (or Super+Shift+H) to pick an agent: Herdr focuses it and the terminal window running herdr is raised
* Toasts next to the badge when an agent is done or needs you

Requires the herdr CLI. Polls "herdr agent list" and runs "herdr agent focus"; nothing else is launched. OpenMenu and Focus are exposed on the session D-Bus (io.github.hungify.HerdrPip) for when a fullscreen app blocks shortcuts.
